visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static shot of a white Muji storage container on a light wood floor, topped with a wire basket filled with various packaged food items, bottles, and cans. White text overlays appear center-top, identifying the brand as Muji. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of a label on the white container, while a woman's hands enter the frame to adjust the basket. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or clean indoor environment. (3) The woman begins unpacking the container, removing various stainless steel pots and pans. She demonstrates how different-sized pots can be nested within each other to save space. Her movements are deliberate and organized, showcasing the functionality of the cookware. (4) The scene shifts to showing a variety of kitchen accessories, including a clear plastic storage box for utensils, aluminum foil trays, and a roll of checkered cloth. Each item is presented individually or as part of a organized set within the large white bin. (5) The final phase shows the woman reassembling the kit, placing the nested pots, utensil boxes, and other accessories back into the large white container before closing the lid. The background remains a consistent, minimalist white interior throughout.
